notes.text: CaptureCheckTests::test_concurrent_check_blocked_by_run_lock (pre-existing, not one of TASK-092's six sanctioned edits) still asserts the old contract: `self.assertIn("decision", out)` after its second, unmocked `capture_check.run` call opens a due opportunity. Under the TASK-092 spawn-and-print-nothing contract this call now spawns the detached worker (real, unmocked `subprocess.Popen`) and prints nothing, so `out == ""` and the assertion fails. This is the same class of change the four sanctioned block-on-due tests received; this one was not in the station's enumerated six and was left untouched per the builder's exact-six-no-others constraint. Fix: patch `commands.capture_check.subprocess.Popen` and assert `out == ""` instead, mirroring the sanctioned edits above it in this file.
